name: vca
summary: Gain cell: Q15 multiply of audio × control cv × a `level` param (default unity). Bipolar `k` (key-follow) and `vk` (velocity-follow) factors (Q15) push the level toward 0/32767 (block-derived `level_eff`). When `level_eff` is 0 the two multiplies are skipped (`level_eff ? … : 0`, bit-exact), e.g. the fm_op self-feedback with `feedback` 0.
